## Summary

Describe the change and its user impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Safety And Documentation

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior, including process argument handling where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG are updated when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, Docker socket mounts, or host-home mounts were added.
